---
title: "1 · From Artificial Intelligence to Neural Networks"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

Big goals of quantum physics that machine learning can serve. The approaches to artificial intelligence, the hierarchy of AI, machine learning and deep learning, and the step from algorithm-driven to data-driven programming, with features extracted by hand or learned automatically. The anatomy of a neural network as a non-linear parametrised function: without a non-linearity depth does nothing, ReLU pieces build any curve, a steep sigmoid becomes a step, and the universal approximation theorem. Regression and classification, and the literature of the course.
